COURT'S OR JUDGE'S ORDERS
CLCON No. 242 of 2022
Shri Sanjaya Kumar Mishra, J.
Mr. Vinay Kumar, learned counsel for the
contempt petitioner.
Ms. Monika Pant, learned counsel for the
contemnors/respondents.
The petitioner is complaining that the
respondents/contemnors did not allow his
representation. However, the learned
Coordinate Bench ordered that if the petitioner
makes such application, within three weeks
from that day, the decision thereupon shall be
taken as per the applicable rules/scheme, as the
case may be within six weeks.
The respondents have taken a decision,
however, the petitioner is not satisfied by the
decision.
In that view of the fact that this Court is of
the view that there is no willful and deliberate
disobedience of the said order.
Accordingly, the contempt petition is
dropped.
All the pending applications stand
disposed of.

(Sanjaya Kumar Mishra, J.)
 26.11.2022
(Grant urgent certified copy of this order, as per Rules)
A/-
